composites.name: DataGrid
composites.definition: No contract change; every emitted event conforms to CompositeEvent; renders 5000 rows without runtime errors; sort/selection/density are UI-state only.

composites.name: Form
composites.definition: Supports happy/error/slow scenarios with no prop changes; lifecycle phase transitions emitted correctly; never references a data layer.

composites.name: FormDialog
composites.definition: Emits OverlaySpec only; owns zero overlay runtime state (no portal/focus trap/escape inside the composite).

composites.name: PageHeader
composites.definition: Consumes derived aggregates as plain props; no data-source coupling; renders correctly in RTL.

composites.name: StatGrid
composites.definition: Pure presentation of primitive aggregates; no async, no fetch, no formatters tied to domain types.

composites.name: DescriptionList
composites.definition: Pure presentation; renders arbitrary item arrays without coupling to domain shapes.

composites.name: EmptyState
composites.definition: Renders under empty scenario without prop drift; no implicit i18n dependency.

composites.name: ErrorState
composites.definition: Renders under error scenario without prop drift; no implicit i18n dependency.

composites.name: LoadingState
composites.definition: Renders under slow scenario without prop drift; uses aria-busy.

composites.name: Pagination
composites.definition: Pure UI controller; emits grid.page.change envelope; never decides server pagination strategy.
